coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass: 13 native-captured French/English searches with 339 ordered result headers, spanning national/regional and sector leads, date-bounded January searches and adjacent-month checks. Twenty-five source cards: five opened, nineteen search-only, one exact-URL 403. E001 is the 9 January Franceville secondary-school march, proposed for inclusion on S001's qualitative hundreds and public-authority transport-fare appeal; S020 separately reports the occurrence/fare issue but not turnout, and S002 shares S001's publisher/author. E002 preserves the Port-Gentil CNSS gate/courtyard action with actual dates null and eligibility pending evidence/threshold, state-target, publicness and continuity review. One out-of-period Franceville 2024 story is excluded. Coverage remains uneven across provinces, January weeks, local languages and archives; the official baseline and Coding Procedure are pending. Physical endpoints, response/violence, CNSS site threshold/ownership and several source relationships remain unresolved. No absence, exhaustiveness or official match is claimed.
